title: Triples with Bitwise AND Equal to Zero
description: Find the number of triples (i, j, k) such that (A[i] & A[j] & A[k]) == 0.
pseudocode:
1. count = {}
2. for x in A: for y in A:
3.   count[x & y]++
4. ans = 0
5. for z in A:
6.   for val, freq in count:
7.     if (val & z) == 0: ans += freq

steps.note: Initialize count map to store results of A[i] & A[j]
Iterate through pairs to compute ANDs (1&1=1, 1&2=0, 2&1=0, 2&2=2)
Iterate through A to check triples with z = 1
Check pairs where (val & 1) == 0: val=0 has freq 2
Iterate through A to check triples with z = 2
Check pairs where (val & 2) == 0: val=0 has freq 2, val=1 has freq 1
